name.description: Name of the project config (the file name without .json)

active.description: Whether this config is the active project

owner.description: Owner of the board, for projects_list and projects_write (omitted when the config cannot be read)

project_number.description: Number of the board, for projects_list and projects_write (omitted when the config cannot be read)

projects.description: Project configs under the projects directory (an empty array when there is none)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
